summary: Describes a way to carry IKE and IPsec packets over a TCP connection so they can traverse middleboxes that block IKE negotiation over UDP. Both the IKE messages and ESP packets are sent inside the TCP connection. It obsoletes RFC 8229. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Some networks block the usual path for secure tunnels. This hides them inside an ordinary TCP connection that the network lets through.

questions: how to run ipsec over tcp
what is tcp encapsulation of ike
